# /locate for a structure whose start chunk was generated by an earlier run of the server: the structure check reads the stored starts from the region
# file (`ChunkScanAccess`) and answers without loading the chunk, a start that is not stored is found by the generation point search and its chunk is loaded
# to read it. Seed 4 has a village_plains whose start chunk is (18, 72) (see cmd_locate_spawn). The chunk is generated, saved and unloaded, then the
# structure check forgets what it learned (what a server restart does); the loaded chunk count after each command shows which of the two paths ran.
command_env
level normal
seed 4
structures true
preload 2
world_spawn
level_seed 3
entity_counter 20
spawn_player A survival 0.5 100 0.5 0 0
gamerule send_command_feedback true
tick 1
cmd forceload add 288 1152
tick 3
dump levels
save flush
unloadall
forget_structure_checks
dump levels
note the start is stored: no chunk is loaded to answer
cmd execute positioned 288 100 1152 run locate structure minecraft:village_plains
tick 1
dump levels
note a structure whose start chunk was never stored: its chunk is loaded to read the start
cmd execute positioned 1000 100 -2000 run locate structure minecraft:stronghold
tick 1
dump levels
